[{"insert":"1 1/4 DB Bench Press + DB Fly on Floor

Two chest movements back to back that combine the quarter rep technique with a fly variation. The 1 1/4 dumbbell bench press adds an extra quarter rep at the bottom.  Lower fully, come up a quarter, return to the bottom, then press fully. This doubles the time spent at the most demanding point of the range. The DB fly on the floor limits the range of motion at the bottom, which removes shoulder stress while keeping the chest under load. Push close to failure on each set.
"}]
